description: Give your small robot a brain. It knows its moves but not how to connect them. Say a goal in a chat and any LLM plans and runs the steps. Microduck, Open Duck Mini, LeRobot, XLeRobot, Aloha Mini, or any ROS base. Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or local via Ollama or vLLM. Simulator, .duck safety contracts, MCP server, memory between runs, flocks.
summary: 🦆🧠 Give your small robot a brain. Tell a Microduck, an Open Duck Mini you built yourself, a Reachy Mini, a LeRobot arm or any ROS base what you want in human language. An LLM (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or a local model via Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp) uses the skills it already has. Simulator, .du
